e2e.auth_notes: The actor is the seeded student 小明 (course 1 enrolled at progress 0), whose credentials come from the sample .env only.

db.notes: One 下一学时 click on course 1 updates student_course (1,24) progress 0 -> 1. expected_delta.json is captured from the pristine app (never hand-written). The schema has no volatile columns (no timestamps/counters): every seeded date is fixed in the dump and the flows fill any date input explicitly, so ignore_columns is empty. All six tables are listed so the capture tooling can warn about any change outside the spec. Shiro sessions live in memory, not in the DB — there is no session table to exclude.
